Ituri rings 13/41 (31.7%), with 31 EDS failed and 9 postponed of 99 alerts and 17 of 92 bodies (18.5%) not swabbed; Nord-Kivu community resistance at Katwa, Beni, Butembo and Kalunguta, decontamination teams short in six zones, 0/10 decontaminated households given kits, 44 EDS postponed and the Bundji cemetery road (Beni) impassable; Tshopo IPC inputs short and family absence hampering swabs; Haut-Uele 4/7 zones sent IPC data and 0/8 decontaminated households given kits; Bas-Uele 16/20 priority facilities without functional triage, 17/20 without 72-hour water storage and 20/20 without mattresses, with a Dakwa household and facility still awaiting decontamination.

Ituri: 380 patients at a printed 37.0% occupancy with no bed denominator, 47 critical; limited capacity at Nyankunde, Kilo, Lolwa, Mangala, Jina and Biakato, a risk of blood stock rupture, no food for 8 patients in Mandima, ambulance movement reporting 13/33; a 60-bed CTE at Biakato is judged urgent.
Nord-Kivu: no patient-movement, bed-occupancy or ambulance data for 16 October, so CTE/CT pressure cannot be assessed; suspect beds were 95.6% occupied the previous day.

Haut-Uele: 44 patients for 169 beds (26.0%), no working Starlink link at every CTE, unpaid staff, nutrition inputs short and water and power insufficient at some CTE; Tshopo: 18 patients for 36 beds (50.0%), no food support at the Bafwasende CT, 7 confirmed cases lost to follow-up, resuscitation equipment short and no specialists at the CTE.

Ituri's frontline-worker target remains to be redefined (1120 vaccinated against a provisional 1000; no data for the day); Bas-Uele cold-chain units are not running, vaccine quantities are insufficient and funds are awaited; Tshopo has a 551-vaccinee gap between its Excel and DHIS2 records and Bafwasende has not reported for four days; the Nord-Kivu vaccination team lacks 2 vehicles and 3 small tents and ARKTEK vaccine transport remains to be confirmed.
